scope: Actual native IPC/FFmpeg/queue/library. Only this fresh app process's own HWND; microphone/system audio always off. Backend 66-second replay proof is tested separately.

checks.case: Explicit component, opaque source/preview boundary, real accelerated-window PNG pixels queued and published
Duration-limit capture binds destination before start; actual video UI pixels, ffprobe metadata and cache lifecycle
Published recording loads real metadata in the native nabmedia Library player without playback
Persistent recording indicator and Stop remain usable from Home
Opt-in replay snapshots only elapsed media, queues a stable result, and releases its OS shortcut when stopped
Replay duration autostop releases the global hotkey; previously published PNG remains unchanged
Resizing only the owned app window yields a preserved interruption; explicit partial recovery keeps partial metadata
